$comment: Pre-registered retrieval thresholds (docs/plan-1.0.md section 8, WP0, WP1, WP3a). `target` values come from the plan and were written before any tuning; they are never adjusted to pass. `baseline` is the shipped 0.9.1 search (src/search.js, AND semantics) measured by `node scripts/eval-search.js --fixture alpinaria --fixture atlas --split all --out test/fixtures/retrieval/reports/baseline-2026-10-24` on 2026-10-24, minus the 95% bootstrap half-width per metric (1,000 samples, seed 20261024), rounded down to 3 decimals; zeroResultRateMax is measured plus the half-width, rounded up. `baseline.bySplit` holds the same floors per split; test/retrieval-eval.test.js asserts the overall floors on both fixtures and the held-out floors on every fixture with at least 150 queries (section 8: a held-out drop larger than the held-out CI blocks a merge). Splits are family-aware: a paraphrase family never spans dev and heldout.

alpinaria.gate: full set (203 queries, above the 150 threshold): pre-registered targets on the full set, overall baseline floors, and held-out baseline floors (a held-out drop larger than the bootstrap CI blocks a merge, section 8); tune only on split dev

target.source: WP1 acceptance, measured with the shipped default languages: auto
target.sectionAnchorHitRateSource: WP3a acceptance on labelled dev queries via get_context
target.hybridSource: WP3c-2 pre-registration (docs/plan-1.0.md section 7), measured with text-embedding-3-small at 512 dimensions on the full set; test/search-acceptance.test.js reads the committed hybrid-0.12 report

atlas.gate: full set (99 queries, below the 150 threshold): pre-registered target and overall baseline floors on the full set with bootstrap CI; dev/heldout are reported, not gated, until the set reaches 150

target.sectionAnchorHitRateSource: WP3a acceptance on labelled dev queries via get_context
target.hybridSource: WP3c-2 pre-registration (docs/plan-1.0.md section 7), measured with text-embedding-3-small at 512 dimensions on the full set; test/search-acceptance.test.js reads the committed hybrid-0.12 report

scale.source: docs/plan-1.0.md section 4.6 and WP1 acceptance; absolute numbers are trended, CI gates on ratios and 3x ceilings (WP8)
